### Class audit

The note is stated on the published quasi-Markovian class, after canonical response-type reduction:

- Zaffalon et al. define quasi-Markovian SCMs by “each endogenous variable has only a single exogenous parent,” with mutually independent exogenous laws; their Theorem 2 gives separate rootwise credal constraints. [Primary source, lines 780–885](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v138/zaffalon20a/zaffalon20a.pdf).
- Shridharan–Iyengar use the same definition: mutually independent confounders and exactly one latent parent per observed variable; maximal C-components correspond to those roots. [Definition 2.1 and C-component setup](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/shridharan23a/shridharan23a.pdf).
- The note’s clique districts, joint response space per district, and product root law are exactly the canonicalized form of that class: [writeup.tex:57](file://<repo-root>/CausalSmith/doc/research/active/scm_supportface_complete_id/discovery/writeup.tex), lines 57–72, especially the arbitrary joint law θ_j on all district response tables and independence across districts.
- Duarte et al. are broader: their canonical finite reduction explicitly covers variables with multiple disturbances and overlapping/nongeared latent neighborhoods. [Proposition 1 discussion](https://duarteguilherme.github.io/pdf/g2.pdf). Thus their general discrete SCM family is an ambient supermodel, not the class on which the note’s success direction is complete.
- Hwang et al. are correctly used only as a positivity/Q-factor method comparator. The note does not import their result as its kernel: the comparator is marked “unmatched / informed by” in core.json lines 14–61, and related work says only that they supply the positive-prefix model at writeup.tex line 45.

So there is no class laundering in the main iff: thm:uniform-id-iff-tensor-span is genuinely complete for the quasi-Markovian exact-support class Θ_S. The honest-scope disclaimer at writeup.tex line 665 accurately excludes overlapping latent-parent neighborhoods.

### Missed stronger statement

The failure half transfers upward by inclusion, but the paper does not state it.

thm:rational-interior-twins constructs θ⁺,θ⁻ inside Θ_S, preserving exact support, strict positivity on every active response type, the observational law, and all but one district law (writeup.tex lines 414–481; solver artifact lines 145–207). Therefore, for every ambient finite-SCM class M_S satisfying Θ_S ⊆ M_S and agreeing on the observational and intervention semantics,

    h_x,y|T(S) ∉ row_Q(B)  ⇒  τ_x,y is not identified over M_S.

Equivalently, identification over any such ambient class implies tensor membership. This applies directly to broad canonical discrete model classes that admit the one-root-per-district models as a subclass. It must **not** be advertised indiscriminately as a result for a syntactically narrower “semi-Markovian” family unless that inclusion is established.

The note currently records only the opposite/downward success transfer: classical identification implies identification on the independent-district-root subclass (writeup.tex line 562). Adding the converse-on-subclass upward transfer materially strengthens the scope and gives the correct asymmetric class picture:

- Tensor membership: iff identification on Θ_S only.
- Tensor nonmembership: nonidentification on every supermodel containing Θ_S.

### Faithfulness receipts

The crux assumptions are used exactly where required:

- Product district independence yields prefix factorization in the solver artifact, lines 10–14.
- Exact support makes each supported-prefix factor positive and licenses cancellation, lines 17–40 and 68–86.
- Realizability is used only to prove ev(T(S)) = S and existence of a fully positive law, lines 52–57.
- The converse uses the exact tensor-space intersection, a one-district kernel vector, and a positive rational perturbation, lines 145–207.
- Hence there is no hidden Hwang-style Q-kernel substitution or unsupported cancellation.

No sharper rate or numerical constant is tier-relevant: the fixed-face uniform CLT is already sufficient, and Berry–Esseen or sharper Hadamard constants would be secondary. Generalizing from the indicator h_x,y to an arbitrary rational response score is immediate but expands beyond the fixed target rather than strengthening its identification claim.

### Concrete D0 directive

Strengthen exactly thm:rational-interior-twins and thm:uniform-id-iff-tensor-span with an ambient-class corollary parameterized by Θ_S ⊆ M_S, stating the necessary-condition/upward-nonidentification implication above. Synchronize def:model-class, TL;DR, related work, prop:destructive-controls, and Honest Scope to name Θ_S explicitly as the canonical quasi-Markovian class and explain the asymmetric transfer. Preserve the current iff only for Θ_S; do not promote the success direction to Duarte’s general overlapping-latent class.
